notes.title: 0.2.0 Playtest Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]What’s New[/h3]
• Added Discord link to title screen.
• Added “Give Feedback” button to pause menu to allow users to submit reports via Discord, Google Forms, or the Steam Community.

[h3]Changes[/h3]
• Updated title screen logo.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
• Game no longer registers inputs when the window is not in focus.
• Title screen lasso animation is now positioned and scaled correctly.

notes.title: 0.1.4 Playtest Release
notes.content:
Join the [url=https://discord.gg/6NuU2ccsA2]Discord[/url] to give feedback on the playtest and follow the development of the game!

[url=https://discord.gg/6NuU2ccsA2][img]https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6257adef93867e50d84d30e2/66e3d74e9607e61eeec9c91b_Logo.svg[/img][/url]

Or email [url=mailto:@imperialpandagames@gmail.com]@imperialpandagames@gmail.com[/url]!

[h1]What’s New[/h1]
•	New color palette and background.
•	New ground tile set to allow much more flexibility in level design.
•	New Camera system that shows more of the game world, moves smoother, and can dynamically adapt to different areas.
•	New render system to allow Harmonicord to adapt to different screen sizes without looking blurry or stretched.
•	New UI system to provide a consistent user experience across all screen sizes.
•	Game window can be switched between windows and full screen on the fly.
•	New platforms Finn can pass upward and downward through.
•	LOTS of other behind-the-scenes changes to improve both development and gameplay experiences.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
•	Added new default option that makes aiming with a controller persistent, so the player can set a throw arc and leave it without needing to hold the right thumb stick.
•	Lasso hooks are no longer solid; instead, yanking the lasso while attached to a hook launches Finn past the hook.
•	Objects no longer land on Finn’s head; instead, he catches them. Watch out though! If it’s too heavy, he’ll be squished!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
•	Throwing and retracting lasso simultaneously no longer crashes the game.
•	Game no longer crashes when pressing Windows + Shift + S
•	Game no longer freezes when picking something up while an object is sitting on the Finn’s head.
•	Objects that are too heavy to lift can no longer be pushed around.
